name: @pipeworx/mcp-42matters

tools.name: fortytwo_app_lookup
tools.description: Look up full details for a single mobile app — title, developer, ratings, downloads/installs, category, price, and more. For Android pass the package name via `app_id` (e.g. "com.facebook.katana"); for iOS pass the numeric App Store id (e.g. "284882215"). Example: fortytwo_app_lookup({ platform: "android", app_id: "com.facebook.katana", _apiKey: "your-token" })

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. "com.facebook.katana") or iOS App Store numeric id (e.g. "284882215").

app_country.description: Optional 2-letter country code for pricing/availability metadata (default "US").

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

tools.name: fortytwo_app_search
tools.description: Search the app store by keyword and return matching apps with pagination. Example: fortytwo_app_search({ platform: "ios", query: "racing games", limit: 20, page: 1, _apiKey: "your-token" })

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

tools.name: fortytwo_top_charts
tools.description: Get a ranked top-chart list (top free, top paid, top grossing, etc.) for a country and category. Android uses `cat_key` (e.g. "OVERALL"); iOS uses `genre_id` (e.g. "36" for the overall/all-apps genre) plus optional `device_type`. Example: fortytwo_top_charts({ platform: "android", list_name: "topselling_free", cat_key: "OVERALL", country: "US", limit: 10, _apiKey: "your-token" })

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

cat_key.description: Android only — category key, e.g. "OVERALL" or a Google Play category id. Default "OVERALL".

genre_id.description: iOS only — App Store genre/category id (e.g. "36" for all apps).

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

tools.name: fortytwo_apps_by_sdk
tools.description: Find apps that integrate a given SDK. Pass one or more SDK ids via `sdk` (e.g. "google-ads-admob"). Useful for competitive/market-share analysis of ad networks, analytics, and other SDKs. Example: fortytwo_apps_by_sdk({ platform: "android", sdk: "google-ads-admob", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-token" })

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

sdk.description: SDK id, or comma-separated SDK ids, to match (apps embedding ANY of them). e.g. "google-ads-admob", "facebook-sdk".

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-42matters forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the 42matters pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
